result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I haven't tested the new matches themselves. The scoping and convention tests I ran pass, but I didn't add tests for the `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` or `-gradle.js` cases.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, a duplicated `html`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **Generated JS and .NET XML:** the patterns `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` only matched a file named exactly `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. The existing content checks (`// Generated by …` on line 1, `<doc>` within the first 2 lines) are unchanged, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. `build.gradle` still matches its own rule.
